picks.title: Thinking Outside The Box: Digital Design In The AI Era
picks.excerpt: A case study in designing AI interaction beyond the text box: how MacPaw built Eney, a character-based AI assistant that prioritizes humanization and personal connection over the default chat prompt. The piece argues human designers remain essential in the AI era and that interface craft, not just model output, is where creative differentiation lives.
picks.rationale: Actionable craft case study on designing AI interaction beyond the default chat box (MacPaw's Eney), from a top-tier design publication — argues interface craft is where differentiation lives.

picks.title: I Design Products. Then I Make Them. There Is No Handoff.
picks.excerpt: Designer Merav Shaked describes rebuilding her portfolio in a single evening by directing AI as a tool rather than delegating to it, collapsing the designer-to-developer handoff entirely. A first-person account of how agentic AI lets one designer own vision through execution, keeping creative control while eliminating the traditional spec-and-throw-over-the-wall workflow.
picks.rationale: Concrete first-person account of collapsing the design-to-dev handoff with agentic AI — directly changes how a designer owns vision through execution tomorrow.

picks.title: Otoy releases OctaneRender 2027.1 in alpha
picks.excerpt: Otoy's next major OctaneRender release adds a new neural-rendering mode that builds on its neural radiance cache to deliver near noise-free interactive rendering at low sample counts (DLSS-like), plus an updated AI Light 2.0 for multi-light scenes. A concrete example of machine learning reshaping the day-to-day rendering and look-dev workflow for designers and 3D artists.
picks.rationale: Fresh, concrete release: neural rendering plus AI Light 2.0 reshape day-to-day render/look-dev for 3D artists, from a credible CG-industry source.
